--- layout: default type_slug: bar title: Horizontal Bar Chart in C# — Ranked Categories as SVG nav_title: Horizontal Bar Chart description: Draw horizontal bar charts in C# with AddBar — room for long category labels, natural for ranked lists. Self-contained SVG, MIT licensed, zero dependencies. permalink: /chart/types/bar/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("Population by City") .Size(700, 420) .XAxis(x => x.Categories.AddRange( new[] { "Tokyo","Delhi","Shanghai","São Paulo","Mexico City","Cairo" })) .YAxis(y => { y.Title = "Population (M)"; y.Min = 0; y.Max = 40; }) .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .AddBar("Population (M)", new double[] { 37.4, 32.9, 27.1, 22.4, 21.9, 21.3 }, cfg => cfg.Color(ChartColor.ChartBlue))) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
